NSS Download Resource Download NSS Cert
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssDownload/:nssId

Downloads the NSS server virtual appliance information based on the specified NSS server ID in a .ova format. .

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
nssId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the NSS server ID

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
